summary: Frontend-only validation of 5 new System Health admin features (Audit Room, Share Link Manager + revoke, Digest Test Recipient, Quarterly Pack toggle, Public Audit Room portal) plus Evidence Locker regression. All 7 test items from the review request passed end-to-end. No runtime error overlay; all required data-testids present and working.
seed_data_creation: Two audit rooms and one evidence share were created and one of each was revoked during testing; residuals expire naturally.
context_for_next_testing_agent: System Health page /app/system-health is stable. Verified flows: (1) page renders with NO uncaught runtime overlay; all 11 admin testids (sh-audit-room-create, sh-links-panel, sh-digest-test-row, sh-digest-test-email, sh-digest-test-send, sh-evidence-monthly, sh-evidence-quarterly, sh-evidence-keep, sh-evidence-period, sh-evidence-generate, sh-digest-preview) present exactly once. (2) sh-audit-room-create opens sh-share-modal with sh-share-url pointing to /api/deploy/audit-room/<token>, toast 'Audit Room created' shown, sh-share-close closes; new sh-room-row-* appears in sh-links-panel. (3) sh-room-revoke-* click yields 'revoked' toast and row disappears (2 -> 1). sh-share-revoke-* similarly works (3 -> 2 after creating a share via sh-evidence-share-*, closing modal, then revoking); revoke toast 'Share link revoked' shown. (4) sh-digest-test-send with empty email surfaces error toast; with 'auditor@example.com' shows 'Test digest sent'. (5) Toggling sh-evidence-quarterly OFF shows 'Quarter-end pack paused' toast, ON shows 'Quarter-end pack on'; monthly toggle does not flip quarterly and vice-versa; state persists across reload — both left ON at end. (6) Public audit room URL returns HTTP 200, contains 'SAP Access Compliance', 'Uptime (30d)', 'Download latest signed evidence' — no auth. /evidence returns application/pdf %PDF-1.4, 36814 bytes (watermarked). (7) Regression: Evidence Locker shows 7 rows with sh-evidence-download-*, sh-evidence-share-*, and 5 sh-evidence-verify-* rows; verify href correctly points to /api/deploy/evidence/verify/<hash>. sh-digest-preview click shows healthy result. Monthly + quarterly pack toggles both left ON at end as required.
